title: About dream-town and finding lost childhood treasures.
content: Today I laid down and took took a nap. I just woke up from this dream. This was a very lucid dream. In my head there is an entire town that I have never been to(IRL) but it's very familiar. Every time I dream of this dream town it's lucid. I've been dreaming of the town, made up friends and houses my entire life (kind of like mall-world). I went to buy pizza in this dream town. I get lost. I accidentally go by one of the houses I have lived-in in this dream town. It's being town down in days. Every plant I have ever planted IRL has been dug up and is bagged up out by the street. People are stopping by and picking thru and picking up the plants and stuff inside. I go inside and my Mother (dBPD and she died ftom complications of dementia) is inside telling people to take whatever they want. She speaks to me yet has no idea who I am. I see ALL of my child hood treasures I have lost thru the years due to moving every single year (father's job). I am delighted to find these things!!! I see things I haven't thought of in many many years (I'm 65). It's all there!!! I gather my stuff up , plants, toys, my Mother's China, my beloved childhood jewelry box and put this stuff in my car and leave. I'm IRL absolutely devastated that home is being town down and used as a public park as I loved visiting that home in dream-town. What the heck am I processing? Thanks y'all 💞
